Maximum number of scale intervals : n ≤ 6000 for class ⟪(III)⟫ instruments or;
n ≤ 1000 for class ⟪(IIII)⟫ instruments.
Applied error fraction pi : 0,5
Minimum input impedance : 300 Ω
Maximum input impedance : 900 Ω
Signal voltage per verification scale interval ≥ : 1,0 μV
Temperature range : -10 °C / +40 °C
Software identification : 1.00 for the 500 Series;
2.00 for the 500-SW Series.
